svg.title: TuxBox runtime compatibility
svg.desc: Current runtime capabilities, retail output, Xbox DLL coverage and shader preparation. A checked circle marks complete coverage, a half-filled circle partial coverage and an open ring incomplete coverage. Shader bars show frontend and preparation coverage. DLL bars show verified exports.

g.title: Runtime capabilities
g.text: Frosty packages and DLL exports inventoried
Memory allocation and working-set controls pass on
Xbox device, command list and presentation controls
Packaged shader pipelines and individual GPU outputs
Lanes tests input and selected audio paths
No second retail title has a recorded launch

g.title: The Matrix Awakens
g.desc: Trial menu-video-audio. Title code reached. Frame verified. Unresolved imports in loaded DLLs: 1

g.title: Frosty shader coverage
g.text: Packaged entries translated in measured compiler snapshots
1,110 of 6,280 packaged entries compiled to DXIL (17.7%)
Translation is not proof of correct rendering. See SHADERS.md for GPU checks.

g.title: Xbox library coverage
g.text: 61 tracked · 245 system DLLs scanned · 11 imports · 1 transitive
Bars: verified exports, not game compatibility. * Frosty import · ~ static dependency · dynamic loads unmeasured.

g.title: d3d12_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 48/54 (88.9%). TuxBox Rust device and command providers with desktop D3D12 root-signature serialization. Two Xbox device profiles, eight feature queries, GPU heaps, guest-backed textures, queues, indirect compute, direct and indirect mesh dispatch, descriptor and query operations, and 32 identifiers. Frosty creates 680-byte mesh pipelines and 712-byte graphics pipelines through ID3D12Device2 and presents 3840 × 2160 frames. A fresh Proton prefix running the checkout-built providers displays the menu and video preview, opens Settings and enters the Wake Up sequence. GPU tests cover indexed draws, depth/stencil writes, NV12 plane copies, and whole and regional copies into a tiled RGBA8 texture with guest-memory writeback and alias readback. The framebuffer-preservation size getter matches the supplied DLL in its initial state. Frosty direct imports verified 6/6. Verified (D3D12XboxCreateDevice, IID_ID3D12Device, D3D12SerializeRootSignature, D3D12SerializeVersionedRootSignature, D3D12CreateDevice, D3D12XboxSetProcessDebugFlags).

dxcompiler_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/4 (50%). TuxBox PE forwarder to desktop DXC. Both SDK factories create a desktop DXC utility object through the Xbox DLL. Tests check blob contents, lifetime and use of a caller-supplied allocator. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (DxcCreateInstance).

xmem.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 13/32 (40.6%). TuxBox Rust CPU memory provider. Nine exports cover heap allocation, working-set statistics, virtual memory, and the CPU side of the title’s 64 KiB physical-page profile. The guest preserves 131,072 bytes across unmap and remap in reversed page order. XMemMakeTag matches the supplied routine on 5,120 inputs. XMemVirtualQuery explicitly reports unsupported pending a verified Xbox success path. Allocation and free calls route through installed callbacks; a local reference control checks argument forwarding and restoring defaults. XMemGetWriteWatch and XMemResumeWriteWatch match the checked suspension transitions and host dirty-page query. Frosty direct imports verified 9/9. Verified (XMemAlloc, XMemGetWorkingSetStatistics, XMemAllocatePhysicalPages, XMemMapPhysicalPages, XMemFreePhysicalPages, XMemFree, XMemFreeDefault, XMemAllocDefault, XMemVirtualAlloc).

xg_xs.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 6/21 (28.6%). TuxBox texture address computer. Computes linear and 4 KiB tiled 2D textures, array slices and packed mip chains. TuxBox and the supplied DLL matched on 9,231,018 texel or block addresses across 78 formats and 156 layouts. A separate check includes eight descriptors from Frosty. XGComputeBufferLayout matches the supplied DLL on 967 buffer descriptors, including invalid arguments and full output guards. The 2D-specific layout and computer exports match the supplied DLL on 7,020 sampled layouts and 81,432 sampled addresses for the checked usage and swizzle profiles. The 1D-specific layout and computer exports match 4,104 sampled linear layouts and 45,144 addresses for 57 uncompressed formats. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (XGCreateTextureComputer).

xgameruntime.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 4/5 (80%). TuxBox Xbox Game Runtime with Rust task queues. TuxBox implements runtime initialization, threading-interface queries and queues. The guest checks manual, threadpool, serialized and immediate dispatch, cancellation and termination. No static PE import path found; dynamic loads are not measured.

xcrdapi.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/118 (0.8%). TuxBox Rust storage queues over Windows file handles, with Rust zlib decompression. Frosty’s storage factory opens files and reads queue entries into game memory. Isolated guests decoded two 64 KiB blocks directly from its retail container on two Proton builds. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (DStorageGetFactory).

gameconfighelper.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 3/24 (12.5%). TuxBox package registry helper using Win32 and WinRT. Implements three of the 24 exports in the reviewed Windows Game Runtime helper. The guest obtains an owned UTF-16 package path and opens configuration keys in both supported registry hives, including the GameCore machine key. Boundary lengths, Unicode and missing keys matched the supplied helper. No static PE import path found; dynamic loads are not measured.

GameInput.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/1 (100%). TuxBox GameInput v0 provider for polling and device status callbacks. Lanes reads keyboard, mouse and XInput state through ordinal 1. TuxBox handles the blocking device enumeration requested by Frosty. With keyboard-to-gamepad enabled, all 48 tested key edges, mouse confirmation and signed mouse-look reached the gamepad reading. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (#1).

AcpHal.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/10 (0%). TuxBox Rust AcpHal provider; runtime validation pending. The Rust provider builds seven of Frosty's imported exports: the host-backed APU heap, XMA context allocation, inert IAcpHal object, and release entry point. The earlier reference-provider trial started the mixer; TuxBox behavior remains unverified. Frosty direct imports verified 0/7. Unverified (AcpHalReleaseShapeContexts, AcpHalAllocateShapeContexts, AcpHalCreate, ApuAlloc, ApuFree, ApuHeapGetState, ApuCreateHeap).

XAudio2_9.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 8/10 (80%). TuxBox Xbox ordinal exports backed by system XAudio2. Eight exports cover all five static imports in Frosty. The guest creates engines through all three tested factory ordinals, instantiates three effects, pans a source and measures the signal on each stereo channel. Frosty direct imports verified 5/5. Verified (#2, #1, #4, #5, #6).

GameChat2.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 13/70 (18.6%). TuxBox Rust chat session, user roster and outgoing frame provider. Thirteen exports cover sessions, encoding bitrate, remote users, user context and outgoing endpoint announcements. Nine are among Frosty’s 15 delay imports. The guest checks payloads, endpoint IDs and borrowed frame lifetimes against the packaged DLL. Frosty direct imports verified 9/15. Verified (ChatManagerInitialize, ChatManagerCleanup, ChatManagerSetAudioEncodingBitrate, ChatManagerStartProcessingDataFrames, ChatManagerFinishProcessingDataFrames, ChatManagerAddRemoteUser, ChatManagerRemoveUser, ChatManagerGetChatUsers, ChatUserGetIsLocal). Unverified (GameChatFailFastWithInform, ChatManagerAddLocalUser, ChatManagerProcessIncomingPacket, ChatUserSetMicrophoneMuted, ChatUserGetRemoteUserMuted, ChatUserSetRemoteUserMuted).

mfplat.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/140 (1.4%). TuxBox DXGI device bridge and Proton Media Foundation. GPU readback verifies the Xbox device-manager reset and surface buffer. The packaged video decoders matched FFmpeg on both NV12 planes. Frosty direct imports verified 1/13. Verified (MFResetDXGIDeviceManagerX). Unverified (MFShutdown, MFCreateAlignedMemoryBuffer, MFCreateMediaType, MFCreateSample, MFStartup, MFCreateDXGIDeviceManager, MFTEnumEx, MFCreateAttributes, MFCreateMemoryBuffer, MFCreateFile, MFllMulDiv, MFCreateWaveFormatExFromMFMediaType).

mfhevcdec.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 0/5 (0%). TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied HEVC decoder. The adapter delivers synchronized D3D12 NV12 samples. Original intro and chase footage passed decoded-frame comparisons. No static PE import path found; dynamic loads are not measured.

mfh264dec.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 1/1 (100%). TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied H.264 decoder. The registered H.264 transform returns D3D12 samples for both 1024 × 512 menu previews. No static PE import path found; dynamic loads are not measured.

mfreadwrite.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/7 (28.6%). TuxBox synchronous PCM source reader. Opens seekable PCM RIFF/WAVE streams, Windows file paths and escaped file URLs. The guest compares 2,501 stereo frames and checks stream selection, seeking, timestamps, end of stream and invalid inputs. Frosty direct imports verified 1/1. Verified (MFCreateSourceReaderFromByteStream).

MSAudDecMFT.dll · Partial · Verified TuxBox exports 2/2 (100%). TuxBox AAC transform adapter using GE-Proton's host decoder. Handles the first format change and end-of-stream drain. On GE-Proton the guest decoded 25 generated and 96 Frosty AAC-LC packets into 48 kHz six-channel PCM. Each channel was compared with FFmpeg. No static PE import path found; dynamic loads are not measured.
